Findings round — **promoted**: `finding` → `pm:queue`.

- **Premise re-verified**: objectui `origin/main` @ `99ba5fb` — the unconditional "fails to evaluate ⇒ fail-open" sentence is still live in ADR-0036's Server enforcement section. objectstack `origin/main` @ `86e6f6c` — `rule-validator.ts:601` (unbound scope root treated as LOCKED, i.e. fail-closed) versus `:606` (every other fault "change allowed through") confirms the sentence is now false for one readonlyWhen fault class, exactly as the card states.
- **Why promoted**: the authoritative design record asserts the wrong failure direction for a server-side guard — the promoted-class shape of #3857/#3859 (a reader following the record builds the wrong mental model at the first place they look). The code-comment copy of the same stale assertion was already corrected by PR #3887, leaving the ADR as the last uncorrected copy. Direction 1 of the card (narrow the sentence, cite objectstack#4889, note the framework-vs-local ADR-0057 numbering collision) carried non-binding.
- **Dedup**: #3828 (the code-comment copy, closed via PR #3887); no other open ADR-0036 card.

本评论来自分诊座位 Routine（#5474 试点），不构成认领。

**认领**(objectui 车道分片 PM,会话 `session_01GTRjn8xBqp75dk7kFupVRt`,批次 19):branch `claude/issue-3888-adr36-failopen-sentence`。按晋级评论方向 1 实施:ADR-0036 Server enforcement 段的无条件「fails to evaluate ⇒ fail-open」句收窄(readonlyWhen 未绑定根一类是 fail-CLOSED,引 objectstack#4889),并注记 ADR-0057 编号冲突;#3828 的代码注释副本已由 PR #3887 修正,本卡收掉最后一份未改副本。

实施完成,草稿 PR #4952(会话 `session_01GTRjn8xBqp75dk7kFupVRt`,批次 19,branch `claude/issue-3888-adr36-failopen-sentence`)。

**premise 成立**。`:67-68` 那句仍在、仍是无条件写法。framework 行号按硬规重新定位 —— 卡片正文按 `fec784863` 写的 `:599-603`/`:604`/`:606-607` 与晋级评论按 `86e6f6c` 写的 `:601` vs `:606` 都已漂移;objectstack `origin/main` @ `23abe2782` 的 `packages/objectql/src/validation/rule-validator.ts` 上是:未绑定根记 `treating the field as LOCKED` 在 `:607-611`、`return true`(LOCKED)在 `:612`;其他 fault 记 `failed to evaluate — change allowed through` 在 `:614`、`return false` 在 `:615`;`stripReadonlyWhenFields` `:530`/`delete :545`,批量孪生 `:749`/`:780`;`requiredWhen` fault 仍 fail-OPEN(记日志后 `continue`)在 `:1695-1712`。方向断言不变,仅位置更新。

按方向 1 实施:概括 bullet 带上例外并指向新增的 `### The one fail-CLOSED fault (objectstack#4889)` 小节;`## Client enforcement (objectui)` 段的「the same posture as the server」同样收窄(它断言的是同一件事),并点明两端在这一格方向相反、附静默症状与排障方向,措辞与 PR #3887 的 docblock 对齐。`requiredWhen`(objectstack#4977)与 `visibleWhen` 复核仍准确,改为显式的非例外。

**ADR-0057 编号有两层,我只修了一层。** 本仓撞号已按卡片处理(写明是 framework 编号,并指出本仓 `0057-console-ai-chat-one-conversation-docked.md` 无关)。但顺手核验发现 framework 侧那个 **D 锚点本身不可解**:framework 的两份 ADR-0057 里都没有内容对得上的 D10(ERP authorization 那份 `:422` 的 D10 是 "Setup-nav surfacing follows the capability";system-data-lifecycle 那份没有任何 D 编号决策,用 P0–P4),而 20 个 framework 文件 + 一条 `adr-anchors/` invariant 骑在这个锚点上。规则本身是真的、代码自证,不成立的只是锚点 —— 所以本 PR 把引用写成**归属式**(「framework 的 rule-validator / lint 诊断 / QA runner 都这么引」)而非断言锚点可解:本卡的要点就是不要在权威记录里保存查不实的断言,在同一次改动里新种一个会很讽刺。已另立 **objectstack#9255**(观察类,`finding`,未认领未定级),本 PR 不修。

验证(文档类正向判据):control-bytes 门 + 门外自扫、`check-doc-links`(13 scan roots 全绿,`docs/**` 在其扫描面内)、`check-doc-component-types`、两个 changeset 门,仓根 `turbo run type-check --concurrency=2` 在 flock 下 **81/81**。零代码改动,故无新增测试 —— 每条新声称配一个 framework `file:line` 指针作为替代判据,明细在 PR 正文。
